summary: Large free sealed car park beside the rail line; homes 60 m or more away.
reasons: Sealed car park with many cars
Rail corridor and bush on north side
Nearest homes 60 m or more away

best_section.where: Northern end of the car park, by the ring, backing onto the trees and railway

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto dense trees and the rail corridor. Mapped houses are 60 m or more away, across the road or the rails.
drivers.access_and_room: Open entrance from Alderson Street; marked bays with plenty of room at the north end.
drivers.traffic: Trains and a street roundabout nearby; the van stands well clear of the lane.
drivers.convention: Mapped public parking, access yes, no fee; many cars parked, so a van will not stand out.

flags: Train noise from the adjacent line
Slope about 2.3% mean, 6% max in places
Pool and club activity at the west edge by day
sun_shade: Mostly open sealed surface; dense trees shade the north and east sides in the morning.
cannot_judge: Time limits or no-camping signs on site
Whether it is busy with commuters or pool users
